title: La Diagonale des Fous
claims: The Diagonale des Fous starts in Saint-Pierre and finishes in Saint-Denis.
The official distance is about 180 km.
The organisers publish a trace map but no public GPX; some sections are private land.
The official course lists about 10,200 m of cumulative climb.
The route crosses the Pitons, Cirques and Remparts national park.
